claims.claim: Used 3 Seaters and 2 Seaters Couch going for giveaway price
claims.evidence: All three photos show only a single 3-seater tufted sofa from different angles; no second (2-seater) piece appears anywhere in the report.
No date-stamped photo, receipt, or purchase evidence in the report.
Only front/top angles shown; underside, seams, and cushion undersides are not captured.
Firmness cannot be judged from static photos; would need a weight-press video.
No way to detect smoke exposure remotely; odor not visible in photos.

risks.risk: Second (2-seater) sofa may not exist or may differ from the one shown
risks.proof: A photo showing both the 3-seater and 2-seater together in the same room
risks.if_unproven: Price only the single 3-seater confirmed by the witness; treat 2-seater claim as unconfirmed inventory

risks.risk: Hidden stains, tears, or repairs on cushion undersides or back
risks.proof: Close-up shots of cushion undersides, seat base, and rear panel
Video of someone pressing down on the seat/arm and rocking the sofa to show leg stability
Video of a person sitting down showing cushion rebound

risks.risk: Fabric material misrepresented (cheap polyester vs premium weave)
risks.proof: Close-up macro shot of fabric weave/texture

risks.risk: Odor/smoke or pet exposure not detectable remotely
risks.proof: No remote proof possible; only in-person inspection can settle this
Any original purchase receipt or timestamped photo from last year
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown/older age, not as 'bought last year'

proof_requests: A single photo/video showing both the 3-seater and the 2-seater together
Close-up shots of cushion undersides and seat base for stains/tears
A short video of someone sitting on the sofa to show foam firmness and frame stability
A close-up of the fabric texture
Any purchase receipt or timestamped proof of age
response.reason: The witness confirms one 3-seater tufted sofa exists, so it can be priced at worst case; the claimed 2-seater is unverified since no photo shows it, so it should not be priced until proven.
